void.$description: Void — Page canvas, full-screen dark sections, and dark-image overlays

charcoal-control.$description: Charcoal Control — Navigation pills, compact filled controls, secondary surface fills, and high-frequency 1px outlines

porcelain.$description: Porcelain — Primary headlines, UI labels, links, icons, strokes, and input text

machine-well.$description: Machine Well — Contained card interiors and dark media panels

hairline-ash.$description: Hairline Ash — Section rules, list separators, and restrained structural borders

muted-steel.$description: Muted Steel — Body copy, descriptions, and secondary explanatory text

dormant-graphite.$description: Dormant Graphite — Inactive step numerals and low-emphasis heading-adjacent metadata

faint-steel.$description: Faint Steel — Navigation counters and tertiary mono metadata

office-times-round.$description: Display headlines. The rounded, high-contrast serif turns large statements into editorial placards; the -3% tracking keeps its broad letterforms from becoming stately or classical.

messina-sans.$description: Primary interface and reading face. Use 400 for body, labels, and controls; use 600 only for 26px and 32px feature headings, where the slight negative tracking gives modules a compressed technical voice.

abc-laica-mono.$description: Navigation, counters, steps, and uppercase metadata. Its light mono weight plus expanded tracking makes microcopy read as coordinates rather than ordinary navigation.
